svg.title: ParticleLab: full weight ESS is not recovered uncertainty
svg.desc: All12 linear-filter points with plus/minus one standard deviation moment summaries, and all 20 static-support failure points. Exact Kalman reference, particle variances, weight ESS and initial ancestry. No calibration or convergence claim.
svg.text: ParticleLab | full weight ESS is not recovered uncertainty
Bootstrap particle filter; exact linear-Gaussian reference; fixed development fixtures, not held-out performance.
Linear: 512 particles, seed 0 shown; all 16 seeds 0..15 retained. Static: 32 particles, seed 0, Q=0, 20 zero observations.
A. Linear filter: moments, not coverage bands
Teal: Kalman. Purple: particle. Black: observations.
Shading: mean +/- 1 SD, not credible coverage validation.
Across 16 seeds: mean RMSE 0.01610; variance RMSE 0.00795.
B. Static latent variance: support failure
Teal: exact. Purple: resampling. Gray dashed: none.
No process noise: missing initial support cannot regrow.
Zero particle variance is not zero posterior uncertainty.
C. Weight ESS, before and after resampling
Purple: before. Teal dashed: carried equal weights.
Gray dotted: without resampling. N=32 on shared scale.
D. Surviving initial particle labels
Purple: resampling. Gray dashed: without resampling.
Label count is ancestry, not effective present-state support.
Static final: ESS 32, one initial ancestor, particle variance 0; exact variance 0.000499972.
Particle mean -0.216360 versus exact 0. Both resampling/no-resampling inherit poor finite support.
Time index on all x axes. All plotted values and domains retained in SVG metadata. Finite RNG; no real-data claim.
